question: Would a larger receive buffer fix the parser? Describe the required repair and regression coverage.

criteria.instruction: No buffer size establishes frame boundaries. Use bounded per-connection state, length checks, ordered complete-frame loop, incomplete suffix retention, complete-payload UTF-8 validation and explicit EOF/failure/reset. Test every split, coalesced/empty/multibyte frames, oversize/invalid/truncated input and failure after prior delivery. New connections start with no old suffix.
Ground the changes in parser inspection, S11 and pending implementation review; distinguish performance buffer choices from correctness.
Do not claim the proposal deployed, silently fall back to another protocol or discard malformed bytes while reporting success.
